content: ऋद्धिः {%f.%} [ऋध्-भावे क्तिन्] .²1 Growth, increase. नियमर्द्धये <ls>Bhāg. 12. 8. 9</ls>. .²2 Success, prosperity; affluence, good fortune. तेषामृद्धिरतीवात्र <ls>Bhāg. 3. 139. 8</ls>. .²3 Elevation, exaltation, greatness. संजीवितः शिशुरसौ मम चेयमृद्धिः <ls>U. 2. 11</ls>. .²4 .³({%a%}) Extent, magnitude, excellence; परिच्छिन्नप्रभावर्द्धिर्न मया न च विष्णुना <ls>Ku. 2. 58</ls>. .³({%b%}) Grandeur, magnificence; व्यक्तर्धि वः क्रीडितम् <ls>Māl. 5. 22</ls>. .²5 Supernatural power or supremacy, perfection. .²6 Accomplishment. .²7 Prosperity personified as the wife of Kubera. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Pārvatī, and of Lakṣmī. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a medicinal plant; (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>केवणी, मुरुडशेंग</ns>) .²10 magic; <ls>MW.</ls>
